Witch Manor

Escape Horror

A multi-mode first-person horror experience. Restore the radio antenna, call 102, gather the key and axe, and escape the manor — or challenge five extra modes with 40 achievements.

W A S D / ZQSD — move  •  SHIFT — run
MOUSE — look  •  E — interact
F — flashlight  •  ESC — pause
T — phone (exit hall)  •  Touch on mobile
